envelope.description: Write unit and integration tests for Scope and its validators

body.title: Write unit and integration tests for Scope and its validators
body.summary: Add flat kebab-case *.test.ts files under src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/ covering: Scope's independently-addressable named fields and a minimal valid design-review Scope, the self-inclusive depth model, each validator's exact field-presence enforcement per (scopeType, scopeLevel), and the sc6 PointerPathValidator integration rejecting an escaping Pointer path -- one test case per testStrategy.testLevels subject, matching ac1/ac2/ac3's acceptanceMapping verbatim.
acceptanceChecks: Every subject named in the LLD's testStrategy.testLevels has a corresponding test case
ac1, ac2 and ac3's provingTests from the LLD's acceptanceMapping all pass
npx tsx --test for the new test files passes with zero failures

tests.name: a Scope with distinct def/hld/lld/plan/tasks/extension/amendment Pointers keeps each field independently addressable
a minimal valid design-review Scope (scopeType='design', scopeLevel='def', only def populated) validates ok:true
validateDesignScope returns ok:false when scopeLevel='hld' but hld is absent while def is populated
validateDesignScope returns ok:true when scopeLevel='hld' and both def and hld are populated
validateDesignScope/validateCodeScope return ok:false with a named violation when called on the wrong scopeType
validateCodeScope returns ok:false when a field deeper than scopeLevel is populated
validateCodeScope returns ok:false when scope.tasks is an empty array at a scopeLevel requiring tasks
a validator returns ok:false naming the (scopeType, scopeLevel) combination itself as invalid when no requirement-table entry exists for it
extension and amendment populated or absent independent of scopeLevel do not affect ok/violations
validateDesignScope returns ok:false with a named violation when a populated Pointer-typed field's path escapes registeredRepoRoot
validateCodeScope returns ok:false with a named violation when a populated Pointer-typed field's path escapes registeredRepoRoot
